name: Sorin, Solemn Visitor
oracle_text:
+1: Until your next turn, creatures you control get +1/+0 and gain lifelink.
−2: Create a 2/2 black Vampire creature token with flying.
−6: You get an emblem with "At the beginning of each opponent's upkeep, that player sacrifices a creature of their choice."
blocked_sentences: +1: Until your next turn, creatures you control get +1/+0 and gain lifelink.

needs.what: a duration "until_your_next_turn" (ending in the controller's next untap step, like the existing BlockProhibition/PlayerProtection/LifeLock durations) on both `pump` and `grant_keyword`, applied to all creatures you control at resolution: +1/+0 and lifelink that survive cleanup and the opponents' turn
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `pump` takes no `duration` at all (op_pump always makes an until-end-of-turn pump), and `grant_keyword` only distinguishes until_end_of_turn from "permanent"; the until_your_next_turn durations that exist are on cant_block/unblockable/grant_protection(player)/lock_life_total/cant_cast_spells_from_zones, not on P/T or keyword grants. Using end-of-turn would drop the lifelink/+1 during the opponent's turn, which is the point of the ability
